clips.title_en: A youth-led poultry cooperative gives entrepreneurs in Ethiopia a pathway to decent work
clips.title_am: አማርኛ ረቂቅ — የአፍ መፍቻ ግምገማ ያስፈልጋል
clips.caption_en: A youth-led poultry cooperative gives entrepreneurs in Ethiopia a pathway to decent work. With support from the ILO, a cooperative in Addis Ababa is showing how a sustainable enterprise can strengthen livelihoods and help create opportunities for you.
clips.caption_am: አማርኛ ረቂቅ። ይህ ትርጉም የአፍ መፍቻ ግምገማ ይፈልጋል።
